summary.intent: Run the audit-fix pipeline on cipher-box UAT findings, auto-fix eligible issues with test verification and atomic signed commits, then ship the branch as a PR.
summary.outcome: Fixed F-03 (BYO status wiring in StorageTab), F-04 (failed-migration rendering and poll restart), F-05 (batch timeout and idempotent progress accounting), marked F-08 not-applicable, and created PR #479 from branch fix/audit-f03-byo-status-wiring.

repo: SSH commit signing is enforced via 1Password's op-ssh-sign and PR signature verification is also enforced — commits cannot be made with --no-gpg-sign.
Committing from a sandboxed shell blocks op-ssh-sign from reaching the 1Password agent; commits must run unsandboxed and 1Password must be unlocked.
The project disallows direct commits to main; all fixes must go on a feature branch.
The audit-uat source reads from .planning/phases/*/*-UAT.md and .planning/phases/*/*-VERIFICATION.md glob patterns.
Phala Cloud env vars (PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY, PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL) in GitHub staging are currently inert — user expects Phala credits soon and they should not be re-flagged in future audits.

code.finding: BYO advisory-quota flag was never synced on save; fix calls vaultControllerSetByoStatus({ isByo: mode !== 'cipherbox' }) after a successful pinning-config save (non-fatal on failure), then fetchQuota() picks up the updated flag.
Failed migrations were not rendering with a clear status string; adding key={migrationRunId} causes React to remount the component after migrationApi.start, restarting polling correctly for new runs.

Batch timeout was 120s (worst case ~130s, causing spurious failures); raised to 300s. updateProgress was double-counting failures — fixed by using failedCidList as the authoritative source for the failed count with a migrated + failed ≤ totalCids clamp.
F-08 (orphaned Phala secrets in GitHub staging) marked not-applicable with rationale so future audits skip it.

workflow: When op-ssh-sign hangs, the recovery procedure is: kill the hung git commit and op-ssh-sign processes, restart the 1Password desktop app, then retry the commit — this consistently unblocks the signing flow.
Running jest inside a package subdirectory leaves the shell cwd in that directory; subsequent git commands from the same shell session will fail unless the path is explicitly set to the repo root.
The audit-fix pipeline classifies findings as auto-fixable vs manual-only before attempting any fixes, making it easy for the user to upgrade manual-only items to auto-fixable mid-session.
STATE.md should be updated and committed after shipping to track PR number and date.

friction: 1Password op-ssh-sign hung three times across multiple commit attempts, requiring process kills, app restarts, and retries — each cycle added ~5-10 minutes of delay.
The sandboxed shell used for background Bash tasks blocks the SSH signing agent socket, making signed commits impossible from within it; required switching to unsandboxed execution.
A stale cwd left in apps/api after running jest caused the first F-04 commit attempt to fail with a detached-HEAD-style error.
open_items: F-08: PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY and PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL in GitHub staging environment are inert — user is expecting Phala credits to fund the staging TEE infra before activating them.

Pre-existing uncommitted files on the branch (.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md, .planning/phases/18-performance-instrumentation/18-VALIDATION.md, Cargo.lock, apps/api/src/metrics/http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts) were intentionally left untouched and are not part of this PR.
